text:
If your Thursday plans are already underway, the day is playing out cloudier and cooler than the warmest guidance suggested, with Burlington at 66 and a steady south breeze around 14 mph by late morning. We should still climb into the low to mid 70s this afternoon, though the sky may only offer a few brief breaks. The lake will be a rougher proposition, with south winds building to 20 to 25 knots and waves up to 3 feet, so keep smaller boats close to shore.

Tonight stays mild and muggy by October standards, with showers becoming likely after 10 and a low near 63. Friday is the wetter turn, cloudy with rain showers, an 80 percent chance of precipitation, and a high around 66, with a quarter to half inch possible. Enjoy the dry daylight today, but wrap up waterfront plans before the late-evening showers arrive.

week.blurb: Mild and mostly cloudy, near 72, then showers likely after 10pm; enjoy daytime plans before the wet turn.
Rainy Friday near 66, with showers likely through the day and a brighter, drier evening.
Sunny and crisp Saturday, near 60, with no rain expected and temperatures dipping to 41 overnight.
Mostly sunny Sunday near 65, a good outdoor day before showers become possible overnight.
A breezy, cooler Monday near 61, with a few showers possible and a colder night ahead.
Mostly sunny and brisk Tuesday, near 53, with northwest wind making it feel like fall.
Sunny Wednesday near 61, with a mild south wind and no rain to disrupt outdoor plans.
